name: maybe_Menu_CalcColumnFlags

summary: Sums a per-member value over the battle party list for a resistance/class index 0..6 using the 1/8/16/32/64/128/256 weight table, for menu display.
evidence: Weight table 1..0x100 matches resistance-chance code; walks battle work +0x4260 party list; single caller is the effect-list builder.

name: maybe_Actor_UpdateSpinTransform
summary: Per-frame spin motion: integrates angular speed, builds rotation from sin/cos and composes it into the attached node matrix.
evidence: Sin/cos helpers and matrix composition visible; spin source inferred; no callers.

name: maybe_Actor_Action_MoveWithEffect
summary: Movement step of an action: integrates velocity into owner position while countdown runs, snaps to destination on last step and starts arrival effect.
evidence: Countdown/velocity integration and arrival-effect start clear; no named caller identifies the action.

name: maybe_Ui_Billboard_UpdateFromActor
summary: Places a billboard sprite from its owning actor: releases stale attach slot, copies actor position/scale into sprite transform and applies fade/rotation constants.
evidence: Vtable slot and 0x7E709C transform constants visible; owning class unknown; only release half covered by named callee.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_UpdateWorldTransform
summary: Recomputes window render transform: copies stored translation and default basis when f_91 set, then selects stored offset or live scene-node position based on f_93.
evidence: Helpers Field_SceneNode_GetPosition and Os_GetGameWork named; no caller and window class unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_EffectNode_SetupFromDesc
signature: void maybe_Field_EffectNode_SetupFromDesc(u32* self, const u32* desc)
summary: Sets up a field effect node from its spawn descriptor: stores descriptor fields, adds sprite child and applies placement via Game_GetWork and trigger checks.
evidence: Named caller Field_SceneSpawnBlock_EffectNodeFromDesc allocates node and passes on-stack descriptor; signature damaged.

name: maybe_Actor_Action_IvyNut_Update
summary: Per-frame update of IvyNut actor action: eases actor toward action target using std_Powf and calls Actor_SelectAttractAnimation.
evidence: Callees Actor_SelectAttractAnimation and std_Powf match IvyNut easing action; caller unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Map_Object_UpdatePlacementScale
signature: void maybe_Map_Object_UpdatePlacementScale(MapObject* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
summary: Resolves placement record through map work, reads 3D scale factors, applies them to actor transform and places object via Map_PlaceObject(owner,0).
evidence: Vtable slot of 0x00779E38; calls named Map_PlaceObject after applying record scale factors; no named caller confirms placement path.

name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectB
signature: void maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectB(u32* scene, int count, u32* nodes, int flags, float* out)
summary: Damaged scene-graph walk that tests ray/mesh intersections for query variant B; called by Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB and the mesh intersect block.
evidence: Decompilation has coprocessor_loadlong/halt_baddata; only named caller is Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB; callees are math helpers (MatrixInverse, bounds, quaternion).

name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectC
signature: void maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectC(float* scene, int count, int nodes, float* out)
summary: Damaged scene-graph walk for ray/mesh intersection query variant C; called by Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC and the mesh intersect block.
evidence: Bad instruction data and unreachable-block removal; only named caller Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC; callees MatrixInverse and bounds builder.

name: maybe_Field_Char_UpdateModelOffset
summary: Blends a character's model position offset toward a target position using a clamped progress factor and std_Powf, then selects an attract animation on the target actor.
evidence: Writes targetActor +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4 and +0x118, uses std_Powf and Actor_SelectAttractAnimation; no callers to confirm subsystem.

name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseFinishedUploads
summary: Reaps completed uploads: walks the live-slot bitmask of four queues, releases finished blocks under the monitor, returns slots to the free list and records completion.
evidence: Only caller is Snd_StreamManager_Update which owns the queue array; slot/free-list bookkeeping clear but release helpers unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_LoadingScreen_Update
summary: Timed transition step that accumulates elapsed time against a threshold, creates a 0x1C state object, blocks input through the manager vtable and completes the load.
evidence: Calls Ui_GetCore, Anim_Sequence_CtorBase, Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle; no caller proves it is a loading screen rather than another timed transition.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleB
summary: Per-particle update integrating position, dispatching the three per-emitter update tables and applying scale/rotation/lifetime curves.
evidence: Two named list updaters call it once per particle; three global dispatch tables explain indirect calls; variant letter unresolved.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleC
summary: Per-particle update that re-caches the emitter transform, integrates velocity, applies fade factors and writes world position into the render node.
evidence: Named list updaters Fx_UpdateParticleListN/O call it once per particle; transform-cache call and four fade factors clear; variant letter unresolved.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleF
summary: Per-particle integration for emitter type F: transforms velocity through the emitter basis, updates sprite/scale accumulators, recomputes normals and applies the colour/state step.
evidence: Named caller Fx_UpdateParticleListL calls it once per particle in its else branch; body is one particle's frame update; F type letter unresolved.

name: maybe_Ui_Talk_CheckLineLength
summary: Looks up a dialogue/layout record by id, scales its signed length byte by the talk context's factor and compares the result against the layout limit at +0xA8.
evidence: Only caller is Ui_ListWindow_SelectEntry; record lookup via func_0063DA3C shared with dialogue layout code; boolean comparison of scaled byte vs +0xA8, but what the byte measures is unproven.

name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CheckFacingTarget
signature: u64 maybe_Field_ActorAction_CheckFacingTarget(void* self, u32 mode, void* target)
summary: Action vtable slot that computes the dot product between the actor orientation and the direction to the target, then ORs the in-front (1) or behind (4) bit into the actor motion flags at +0x290.
evidence: Appears in five action vtables; body computes dot product from actor quaternion fields and target position and ORs 1/4 into f_290; no named callers.

name: maybe_Gfx_BuildOrthonormalTransform
signature: void maybe_Gfx_BuildOrthonormalTransform(void* scratch, CameraTransformOut* out, u32* arg3, u32 token)
summary: Builds an orthonormal transform from the two basis/position pairs at work+0x74, normalising and writing position plus 3x3 rotation.
evidence: No caller or vtable; math identical to 0x4A06E0; only callee is Os_GetGameWork, so subsystem attribution is unproven.

name: maybe_Gfx_BuildSegmentBasis
summary: Derives a marker segment from the two points at work+0x74: normalises the direction, writes start + direction*8 and builds the orthonormal basis.
evidence: No caller or vtable; same math as 0x3F3E90; segment construction (start + dir*8 + basis) is clear but attribution unproven.

name: maybe_Os_LookupParamEntry
summary: Reads a 0x40-byte parameter header, searches its four 0x10-byte entries for type byte 0 and unpacks two 12-bit fields plus payload, falling back to a scan and fixed 0x800/0x800/1.0 defaults.
evidence: Only caller is damaged maybe_Snd_LoadArchiveTailArm; calibration-like defaults (0x800, 1.0f) do not identify the table.

name: maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline
signature: void maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline(float* now, u32* base, u32* out, u32 request)
summary: Converts the current system tick and a packed timeout field into a 64-bit deadline using the 1e6 scaling constants shared with the save worker.
evidence: Issues svc 0x28 GetSystemTick and does 64-bit multiplies by g_0011E0C4/CC/D0 with shift 0x12; only caller is Save_AsyncReadWorker, but units are inferred.

name: maybe_Math_EulerAnglesToVector
signature: void maybe_Math_EulerAnglesToVector(float* out, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ)
summary: Builds a rotation from three axis angles using sin/cos/sqrt blocks and writes the resulting first basis vector to out.
evidence: Neighbours Math_QuatMultiply and sin/cos helpers confirm the maths family; angles arrive in in_s0..in_s2 and only caller is unnamed, so argument order stays uncertain.

name: maybe_Gfx_PlaceAlongViewDirection
summary: Places self at self+0x24 units along the horizontal direction from the camera towards the player, storing the result in self+0x14/0x18/0x1C and setting self+0x28 = 1.
evidence: Clean direction/normalise/scale/store over camera and player transforms; no caller and no view matrix update, so wording is descriptive.

name: maybe_Field_NpcPlayNutAndFaceTarget
summary: Field-NPC gesture: plays the 'Nut' motion unless mode is 0xC, switches the model pose, turns the NPC toward the linked actor and sets the wrong-facing byte.
evidence: 'Nut' literal at 0x0074754E shared with maybe_Field_Npc_SetMotionNut; two vector normalisations and facing byte visible; no caller confirms the two-handed pose/linked-actor reading.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyActorProjection
signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyActorProjection(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, void* outMatrix, u32 mode)
summary: Window virtual (slot 7): builds a projection matrix for the attached 3D actor, selects one of two stored frustum constants for mode 2/3, fills the matrix and applies it to the node.
evidence: Sits in vtable 0x00765508 slot 7 next to Ui_Widget_UpdateAnimatedChildren; matrix built via func_0065DB8C/func_00125558 and applied via vtable +0x30; no named caller.

name: maybe_Actor_Action_GrabNut_Update
summary: Per-frame action update for GrabNut: blends owner model position toward target using std_Powf easing.
evidence: Matches position-offset easing algorithm in 0x004CE218 (IvyNut) and uses confident std_Powf, but caller is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Fx_RenderBatch_Init
summary: Constructor of a render-batch object: zeroes the header, builds three intrusive lists through 0x001252C8 with the same 0x008386FC list template, sets default depth/near-far values 240.0/400.0.
evidence: One-shot constructor (0x1D8 bytes of fields zeroed and defaulted, three list heads built); no caller, so the render-batch owner is still inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_InitTextureSlotUV
signature: void maybe_Gfx_InitTextureSlotUV(int self, int slot, int enabled)
summary: Per-slot texture setup: stores the enable flag, reads two dimensions out of a tagged 0x82 descriptor record through 0x0056C738 when enabled, converts them to floats and resets the slot's UV rectangle to (0,0)-(1,1).
evidence: No callers or vtable references; descriptor scan only shows it consumes the same tagged records as the named glyph/overlay builders.

name: maybe_Anim_BuildSampleBuffer
signature: void maybe_Anim_BuildSampleBuffer(AnimTrackTable* src, void* values, void* dest)
summary: Builds multi-track animation sampling working buffer: calculates track strides and allocates sampling segments.
evidence: Reachable through animation track dispatch tables, but layout and track element format remain unverified.

name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_FinishMotion
summary: Finishes the actor's current motion: takes a handle-table release, applies the final transform, copies the stored rotation, toggles the scene flag, re-finalises the actor, clears the motion handle and returns 1 when a motion was active.
evidence: Gfx_HandleTable_Release is a confident callee and the surrounding module is the Gfx actor-motion code; individual scene writes still only described and no caller.

name: maybe_Ui_TextFade_Update
summary: Fade/scroll animation step for a text element: runs a small 0..4 state machine, interpolates the element's alpha towards the target and accumulates the phase; states 4/reset restore the initial values.
evidence: Sibling vtable slots 0x0031F288/0x0031F2EC hold the widget's start/stop tween entries, so this is the update of that embedded tween; the 'text' part still comes from +0x78/+0x68 fields rather than a named caller.

name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CtorB
summary: Tiny constructor that runs Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00765AFC and stores 0.6f/1.0f/0; called from Model_AttachAccessoriesAndWeapons, so it is an action subclass ctor but the specific action is unidentified.
evidence: Calls Action_CtorBase, sets vtable g_fieldActorTurnActionVtable and three float fields; only caller Model_AttachAccessoriesAndWeapons does not identify the action.

name: maybe_Battle_UnitModel_HidePartnerPart
signature: void maybe_Battle_UnitModel_HidePartnerPart(UnitModel* self, int arg2, int arg3)
summary: Resets unit-model display values (scale 1.0, timer 10, flag 1) and, for the unit with model id 0x350, calls its vtable+0x50(0) and the attached model's vtable+0x4C; no caller confirms the 'hide partner part' intent.
evidence: No callers; body scans battle unit lists +0x428C for id 0x350 and makes two disable-style virtual calls; Model_SetupPartsFromTable callee.

name: Fx_SpawnParticleBatch
summary: Spawn routine: for each remaining emitter particle it takes a block from the particle pool, initialises position/velocity/colour/scale from the template and RNG ranges, and links it into the active/free lists.
evidence: Called by maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleTrail when the spawn timer elapses; body allocates from g_fxSystemParticlePool and fills exactly the fields the per-particle updaters consume.

name: maybe_Ui_Gauge_StartValueAnimation
signature: void maybe_Ui_Gauge_StartValueAnimation(void* self, int arg2, int b, int c, float value)
summary: Initialises a gauge fill animation: clamps the input ratio to [0.5,1.0], converts it to a 2400-unit counter, stores start/end counters and callback ids, and begins the widget animation; decompilation is damaged (in_fpscr) and there are no callers.
evidence: Finds the 'gauge_line' pane and updates its width; 2400-unit counter visible; no caller and damaged FP status spillage.

name: maybe_Math_EaseCurve_Vec2BackOut
signature: void maybe_Math_EaseCurve_Vec2BackOut(float2* out, const float2* from, const float2* to, float t, float duration)
summary: Back-out easing kernel for a float2 vector: applies the overshoot curve through libm 0x00672E44 before adding the start value; no caller in the readable tree.
evidence: 2D vector easing kernel calling libm helper 0x00672E44; caller FUN_006E6F04 unrecovered, curve family inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_NewRenderQueue
summary: Allocates and initialises a 0x348-byte render-state queue: 16 slots each with 0x18- and 0x10-byte descriptors, clears texture/handle words and stores 0.5f in each 0xC-byte tail; returns 0 when the allocator hook is null.
evidence: 16 slots with per-slot texture handles and 0.5f match a 16-texture-unit render-state table; allocator hook called through caller-supplied vtable; only caller Snd_StopStreamTransfer does not confirm.

name: maybe_Os_Timer_ConvertTicks
signature: void maybe_Os_Timer_ConvertTicks(s64* outMs, int stem, s64 ticksA, int stemB, u32 perSecond, int scale)
summary: Converts a 64-bit tick delta to milliseconds: subtracts the two 64-bit stamps, scales by the per-second factor, converts through the double helper 0x00124ACC, rounds and stores value*1000; the 0x20C49BA5E353F7CF magic is the inverse of 1000.
evidence: 1000-inverse magic and final multiply by 1000 support ticks-to-ms; callers include maybe_Os_PerfSample_Loop; argument list is a guess.

name: maybe_Trail_UpdateDirection
summary: Per-frame trail update with a lazily built global pool: on first use it allocates and zeroes the shared 0x1C-stride pool, then aims self's +0x9C vector from the pool object's +0xB0 base along the normalised direction from +0x224..+0x22C scaled by +0x230 and sets the dirty byte +0x118.
evidence: First callee is maybe_Trail_UpdateGeometry; pool allocation is only the lazy prefix of a per-frame direction update; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_MessagePart_ApplyFadeParams
signature: void maybe_Ui_MessagePart_ApplyFadeParams(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 part)
summary: Builds a fade parameter block from float literals scaled by an incoming float and hands it to an unnamed helper, then starts the layout's fade animation via virtual +0x30.
evidence: No callers, callee 0x00125558 unnamed, literals only; decompilation damaged (in_s0).

name: maybe_Sound_CalcDspAdpcmStep
summary: Computes two 16-bit coefficients (with a square-root term) from a scale/step pair, stores them at +8/+10 and copies them into the DSP register block with dirty flag 8.
evidence: Called from Sound_Voice_ApplyPendingParams, Sound_Voice_UpdatePlayState, Snd_InitChannels and Gfx_MovieTrack_Start — clearly sound-voice coefficient math, but the exact ADPCM-step meaning is still inferred.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTarget
signature: void maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTarget(FxEmitter* self, int arg2, int target)
summary: Interpolates the emitter position toward the target in fixed steps, invoking the per-step callback from the table at 0x007AEB6C for intermediate positions.
evidence: Called by both emitter update variants (0x0052C26C, 0x0052F10C); distance clamp/step loop visible but callback table and target fields unnamed.

name: maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio
signature: float* maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio(float* out, int record, int flags, int count)
summary: Damaged Thumb routine that appears to clamp a ratio to [0,1] and walk a record list; body cannot be re-derived.
evidence: coprocessor_function/unaff_r7 damage; only caller is maybe_Field_HandleList_Ctor; no reliable contract.

name: maybe_Sound_InitWaveBlock
summary: Clears the caller's offset word, zero-fills the 0x50-byte block at self+0x1AB4 and stores float 1.0 as its first word (default gain).
evidence: Only callee is Container_ResizeArray; no callers; which sound sub-object +0x1AB4 is remains a guess.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_BeginSubTweenIn
summary: Queries the widget controller at +0x14 and initialises the tween block with duration 10, progress 0 and the active byte set.
evidence: Sits in the Ui_Widget tween family (StartSubTween/StopSubTween/BeginSubTweenOut) but all siblings are still maybe_; constant 10 is the only hard fact.

name: maybe_Monster_Model_InitSubObject
summary: Initialises the model's embedded sub-object: sets slot byte +0x1DC to 0xFF, re-creates the animation handle via 0x0047E1FC on +0x144, restores default scale 1.0f and points the sub-object vtable at self+0x2D4.
evidence: Vtable slot with no named siblings; callee 0x0047E1C0 is Battle_Ui_UnitModel_ApplyZOffset; field writes read from code.

name: maybe_Fx_CopyEmitterBaseTransformScaled
summary: Copies the emitter base transform like 0x00524C68 but first scales the particle scale by f_300 + (1-f_300)*(1-dt), so a fading particle inherits a shrunk base transform.
evidence: Fade re-scaling lerp with in_s0 is clear and the copy matches its pair 0x00524C68; field meaning inferred, no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_ScrollList_ApplyRowEffect
signature: void maybe_Ui_ScrollList_ApplyRowEffect(unsigned arg1, unsigned rowKey, int rowIndex)
summary: Looks up an 8-byte-stride table entry by row index, checks its stored key against rowKey>>6, then applies the row resource via 0x002A9570 and sets fade/duration fields (1.0f, 0.209f) on the object from 0x005F5818.
evidence: Table at 0x7B7F28 with 8-byte stride and key compare rowKey>>6 are visible, but no callers and the row owner/effect meaning are unnamed; callees are Anim_ActionSeq_StepFrame and Gfx_EffectPart_ResetToDefault, suggesting animation/effect rather than UI scroll list.
